about: Public constants of the shared unit: frames, classes and editions, limits, the envelope, the forced numerics, the frame protocol, the registers, default host profiles, the description policy, and what a model run reports in place of a thermal model and reply noise. Imported by the bus layer and the public runner. Holds nothing of the law of drawing, of the thermal model or of the noise law.
